jobs.description:
**Position Summary**



Natera is at the forefront of personalized genetic testing, transforming the management of disease worldwide. As we scale our life\-saving diagnostics, we are fundamentally transforming our approach to software quality and reliability.



We are seeking a highly technical, hands\-on, and high\-agency Principal Engineer, Software in Test (SIT) to join our Oncology Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (CGP) Product Engineering team. In this technical leadership role, you will serve as the test architect and lead developer for our product integration efforts, ensuring we deliver robust, on\-time solutions across our CGP portfolio. You will act as the technical backbone for validating our most complex "Pillar" projects — operating across a sophisticated system of interconnected software products and distributed microservices. This demands deep, expert\-level mastery of the system from two dimensions: working closely with architects to understand how it is built, and partnering with product managers to understand how it is used. You will translate that dual expertise into tests that reflect real\-world complexity end\-to\-end — from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting — catching failure modes that only someone who truly knows the system would anticipate. You will bring an AI\-native mindset as a core differentiator — leveraging advanced LLM methodologies to auto\-generate test scenarios, analyze system logs, surface anomalies, and continuously optimize our CI/CD pipeline.



Crucially, while this is an individual contributor role, you will operate as a central leader — driving consensus, architectural alignment, and engineering excellence through influence rather than formal authority across Engineering, R\&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams. You thrive in fluid environments, adapt quickly to change, and chart a clear path forward even amid unknowns.

**Technical Test Strategy \& Integration Architectur
